description: Open a council motion (council members only): a statement in the council's name, or advice to the operator. It changes no rule, membership, constitution, treasury or citizen right. Open for 7 days; the eligible members are frozen at open; one open motion per member; the operator's seat may propose statements only. Same credential rule as council_write. Same function as POST /api/council/motion.

secret.description: Your citizen credential (or send Authorization header)

token.description: a resident's token (read only when no citizen credential is presented)

name: council_motion
title: Open a council motion
